influences.project_interpretation: External agent-harness ideas inform the operating model, but user-confirmed card quality rules are the final authority for this workspace.

operating_model.progressive_disclosure: Read the smallest relevant spec subset, escalate only when the task crosses product, content, interaction, or box boundaries.
guardrails: content-quality blockers
sample before batch
user-only final approval
legacy status demotion
tts text/audio separation
formal audio readiness requires audio generation contract and reviews/audio_qc record
no harness and bulk-content mixed PR
recorded upstream catalog alignment issues
read-only card quality audit for legacy and candidate corpus risk signals
card quality audit reports must match the current card corpus fingerprint

new or changed sample and approval records must link the current card quality audit report; historical records remain archive evidence and only complete current approval plus complete current linked self-review may authorize current formal use
candidate sample PRs use scoped audit reports under reviews/audit_scopes instead of committing global report refreshes
content sample PRs must not carry global report refreshes or non-scope self-review fingerprint churn
content sample PRs must replay the current scoped card quality audit before accepting changed scoped-audit evidence

all cards that carry quality_metadata must use schema and content-quality enums; untouched legacy cards may omit metadata, but any added or modified candidate card must pass current complete metadata validation without grandfathering
all files consumed under card_boxes_json use the canonical governed filename, and changed candidate cards are derived from NUL-delimited merge-base-to-head card objects rather than declared scope

every JSON change under agent_self_review, approved_batches, drafts, or audit_scopes triggers content-candidate validation without relying on a filename prefix; only the four exact repository-declared template paths are excluded; agent_self_review and approval records must be direct regular JSON children, recursive discovery rejects nested records, and Git paths are preserved exactly with unusual separators failing closed
current scoped audits materialize the complete immutable HEAD card_boxes_json tree so deleted or renamed base paths cannot leak into the replay

each changed candidate requires exactly one changed review coverage; standard self-review entries are compared with their unique HEAD corpus card even when the card did not change, and quality_metadata deeply matches every field except the independently validated artifact-local review_status

standard three-card samples prove exactly three immutable-HEAD-matching snapshots per declared box prefix, carry complete batch-level progression, risk, representative-card, and next-step conclusions, and standalone harness validation compares snapshot interaction, knowledge, and all quality_metadata except review_status with the current corpus; residual closure evidence requires an explicit residual scope type and direct scoped audit and cannot authorize a newly added card

every new or changed standard, residual-closure, or full-track review or approval record uses a direct current scoped audit; the pre-cutover index and every legacy record it names are byte-for-byte immutable against the active repository commit that introduced the index

every new or changed direct scoped-audit JSON artifact exactly matches a current immutable-HEAD replay even when unlinked; standalone harness validation rejects malformed tracked artifacts, replays current-fingerprint artifacts, permits structurally valid unchanged historical fingerprints, validates unchanged historical self-review against the immutable artifact fingerprint and historical rule set without current-card or current-track parity, classifies historical approval as archive evidence rather than current authorization, and hash-pins explicit legacy exceptions so unrelated future card changes do not force evidence churn

the four exact review and approval template paths are regular files whose complete standard or full-track placeholder shape matches the distinct doc-manifest authority, and actual approval records require a timezone-qualified ISO approved_at, non-empty summary, non-empty unique scope arrays, and non-empty unique representative cards inside scope; current-authorization consumers accept only direct canonical non-template approval evidence with complete formal fields, exact queue scope, and a direct canonical complete linked self-review when those records, both scoped reports, the active audit script, and active audit rule spec are regular committed evidence or authority whose worktree, index, and one fixed HEAD modes and bytes agree, independently regenerate the complete current card-quality audit, require both scoped reports to be exact replays, and recheck the fixed HEAD/index snapshot, captured file modes/bytes, and corpus fingerprint before returning rather than trusting tracked status, a current digest, or self-declared summary, while historical records remain archive-only

full-track remediation records are aggregate human-review evidence with no cards property; exact sample flags, direct current scoped audit, structured non-automation human identity, per-box pass evidence, complete zero-hard-blocker quality_audit summary, non-empty unique in-scope representative cards, and complete ready batch summary/empty-risk/next-step evidence are required before strict equal non-empty unique scope and coverage IDs can count; those IDs must equal the complete declared track card and box-prefix sets in immutable HEAD, and merge-base plus HEAD track membership must be the same non-empty set so aggregate coverage cannot authorize added cards

changed elimination cards use explicit unique elimination_items IDs, ID-based answer_key.correct_items, and a temporary eliminable_items text/is_correct preview projection; untouched legacy text-as-ID migrations remain read-only compatibility only
multi-prefix content PRs require explicit handoff or residual-closure evidence proving a single review unit
residual blocker closure reviews are not 3-card sample approvals and must not recommend user confirmation
agent-managed git lifecycle for tracked-file changes
hint_layer enhancement is not a standalone card interaction
sample quality gate links quality metadata, blocker scan, self-review, and user approval records
